collisionPolicy: Visual prop placement never silently changes the grid. Solid prop footprints must be covered by existing B/C/# occupancy, or require explicit grid edit. Runtime visual fit is not navigation validation.
cryoMirrorConvention: Room FBX root is (-1,1,1). CryoProps child box cancels with (-1,1,1), so anchor x/y/z are ordinary world metres. Avoid applying either mirror twice.
defaultPreviewPolicy: Prefer copied previewPath for recognizable palette; exact material/lighting match requires current Unity rendering. Do not run CryoSoftSceneInfo or gameplay components in edit-mode preview.
